study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Coupe et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2022
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Training datasets: C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI. Validation datasets: AIBL, MIRIAD, ADNI (sMCI/pMCI). C-MIND, NDAR, and ICBM are not listed in the dataset table and are marked as Unknown in the answer.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)." ... "C-MIND" ... "NDAR" ... "ABIDE" ... "ICBM" ... "IXI" ... "OASIS" ... "ADNI" ... "TABLE 2 External dataset used for validation ( N = 1,039)" ... "AIBL" ... "MIRIAD" ... "ADNI"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset, Table 1; Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset, Table 2

answer.C-MIND: training dataset for model construction (CN/AD trajectories)

answer.NDAR: training dataset for model construction (CN/AD trajectories)

answer.ABIDE: training dataset for model construction (CN trajectories; part of training set)

answer.ICBM: training dataset for model construction (CN trajectories; part of training set)

answer.IXI: training dataset for model construction (CN trajectories; part of training set)

answer.OASIS: training dataset for model construction (CN/AD trajectories); also used for training in sensitivity analysis

answer.ADNI: training dataset for model construction (CN/AD trajectories); testing dataset for MCI prognosis (sMCI/pMCI); testing in sensitivity analysis

answer.AIBL: testing dataset for AD vs CN validation; also used for training in sensitivity analysis

answer.MIRIAD: testing dataset for AD vs CN validation; also used for training in sensitivity analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Training dataset used to build lifespan models; testing dataset used to validate AD vs CN and MCI prognosis; sensitivity analysis swaps training/testing datasets (AIBL/OASIS/MIRIAD for training; ADNI for testing).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)." ... "To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD) to perform AD versus CN diagnosis task." ... "In addition, we used subjects with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from ADNI to estimate the capability of our models on prognosis task (Table 2)." ... "Finally, in order to test the consistency of our findings, we changed training and testing datasets: AIBL, OASIS, and MIRIAD databases were used for training and ADNI was used for testing."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset; Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.2 Testing dataset; Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.3 Sensitivity analysis

model-2.model-name: AD trajectory (uses young CN in model construction)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: CN trajectory uses all CN subjects in training dataset (N=2,655). AD trajectory uses CN subjects younger than 55y (N=1,874) together with AD patients.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "This dataset was composed of 2,655 CN subjects (CN) and 377 patients with AD." ... "CN subjects younger than 55y ( N = 1874) were used to estimate both CN and AD lifespan trajectories." ... "For CN trajectories, we used the N = 2,655 subjects from 9 months to 94y of the training dataset"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset; Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.4 Lifespan model estimation

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Weighted mean age for CN trajectory computed from Table 1 CN rows using N and mean ages; min/max inferred from reported age ranges (0.74 to 94 years). For AD trajectory, only age criterion for CN subset (<55y) is reported.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset, Table 1; Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 sex counts summed across CN rows in Table 1. Sex breakdown for CN subset younger than 55y (used in AD trajectory) is not reported.
